subject: ela
intro: Apply knowledge of language, syntax, and style.

items.prompt:
Varying your sentence structure is varying your:
A) syntax
B) spelling
C) margin

A guide to formatting and citation (like MLA or APA) is a:
A) style manual
B) dictionary
C) thesaurus

Following a style manual keeps a paper's citations:
A) consistent
B) random
C) hidden

Why might a writer VARY their syntax?
A) to create rhythm and emphasis and avoid monotony
B) to confuse readers
C) to use fewer words only
items.answer: A) to create rhythm and emphasis and avoid monotony

steps: Variety aids style. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to create rhythm and emphasis and avoid monotony

items.prompt:
A short, punchy sentence placed after several long ones mainly:
A) emphasizes that short sentence and varies the pace
B) ruins the paragraph
C) has no effect
items.answer: A) emphasizes that short sentence and varies the pace

solution.answer: A) emphasizes that short sentence and varies the pace

items.prompt:
To check whether your citations follow the right format, consult a:
A) style manual
B) weather report
C) calendar

A student's essay is all medium-length, identically structured sentences. The BEST revision for style is to:
A) vary sentence length and structure for rhythm and emphasis
B) make every sentence the same length
C) remove all punctuation
items.answer: A) vary sentence length and structure for rhythm and emphasis

solution.answer: A) vary sentence length and structure for rhythm and emphasis

items.prompt:
Understanding how language functions across CONTEXTS mainly helps a writer:
A) make effective style choices and comprehend texts more fully
B) ignore grammar
C) write only one way
items.answer: A) make effective style choices and comprehend texts more fully

steps: Informed, flexible use. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) make effective style choices and comprehend texts more fully
